records.tagline: The Markdown editor for Mac you can ask for anything

It works with Claude Code or Codex on your plan, Apple Intelligence, a local model or your own key. The editor has live preview, math, Mermaid and Obsidian vaults. 15-day free trial.

records.name: Papyras
records.tagline: For people who still read the last page
records.description: Blogs are out and AIs are in, but some of us still read the last page. Papyras is for them. Writers get a calm, book-like editor: write chapter by chapter, publish with a cover and contents page in a few clicks, and get help from an AI that runs on your own computer. A blog is there too, if you want one.

records.name: Pine Drama Studio
records.tagline: The open-source Cursor for AI filmmaking
records.description: Pine Drama Studio is an open-source desktop studio for AI filmmaking. Bring your screenplay and collaborate with AI agents to create characters, locations, storyboards, shots, and final cuts. Direct the production through chat, review and approve results on a visual canvas, and customize your production workflows. Built on Code-OSS and powered by Pine Computer. Your project lives in a local folder on your Mac.

records.name: OffiAI
records.tagline: Office, with its last two letters swapped for AI.

records.name: Zoom Slides
records.tagline: Turn your Zoom meetings into ready-to-present slides
records.description: Zoom Slides is an AI-powered presentation maker that turns your meetings, documents, and ideas into polished, editable decks. Instead of starting from a blank slide, let Zoom AI turn meeting transcripts and summaries into structured presentations with professional layouts, visuals, and speaker notes. Refine content with AI, collaborate with teammates, and export to PowerPoint. Your meeting ends, and your presentation is already taking shape.

records.name: Intelligent Eyewear
records.tagline: Samsung and Google bring Gemini AI to smart eyewear
records.description: Samsung Intelligent Eyewear brings Google Gemini into lightweight smart glasses designed with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker. Ask questions about what you see, translate menus, navigate with Google Maps, capture photos and videos, and manage messages hands-free. Featuring a 12MP camera, open-ear audio, up to 9 hours of battery life, and 30 design variations. Preorders are open in the U.S., starting at $395, with availability beginning December 10.

records.name: readywhen
records.tagline: Your personal assistant that lives in email around the clock
records.description: readywhen is the personal assistant on email. Email it a job, the same way you'd email a good assistant. Just email assistant@readywhen.ai to get started. No account setup needed.

records.name: OpenFrame
records.tagline: AI agents that run your IT. You approve every fix.

Fae answers employee IT requests so your team can focus without constant interruptions. A weekly report shows leadership what got done. Endpoint management, AI agents, and IT support in one platform for $1 per device.

records.name: Blomma for Organizations

records.name: Docsy

records.name: Findy
records.tagline: Find Files on Your Mac by what you remember
records.description: A Mac app that finds files from plain-language searches such as “pdfs from gmail last week”, "videos over 1GB", "photos from Greece" and by the text inside images and PDFs. Everything stays on the Mac.

records.name: Zode
records.tagline: The fastest, cheapest cloud VMs for agents
records.description: Zode runs Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode in parallel sandboxes that fork in under a second with Docker and caches intact. A flight recorder shows what every agent did, a ledger shows what each PR cost, and your API keys never enter the sandbox.

records.name: Flamigo
records.tagline: Turn rough notes into beautifully designed slides
records.description: Paste your notes, review the outline, and let Flamigo design the slides. Compare designs for a slide, then fine-tune its layout in the editor. Start free and export to HTML, or export to PowerPoint with editable text on Pro.

records.name: Curates
records.tagline: The all-in-one platform for creators
records.description: Curates is where creatives keep, share and show their work. Send clients a review link with comments, approvals and downloads. Add any photo to your portfolio website in two clicks and build a private showcase for every project. No exports, no re-uploads.

records.name: Nexus
records.tagline: Make agents deploy your AI products faster for customers
records.description: Nexus is a self-learning context layer that helps forward deployed (FDE) teams move faster. It structures your deployment context into something proactive, adaptive, and that does all the work for you including codifying playbooks, surfacing and shipping product signal, taking high priority tasks, and highlighting repeatable work. This means agents take on your most complex FDE work and deliver it fast and reliably for customers.

records.name: Notebook to Notes
records.tagline: Move your OneNote notebooks to Apple Notes, 100% offline
records.description: Move your Microsoft OneNote notebooks to Apple Notes on your Mac. Download them from OneDrive, drop thezip in the app and click Import. Sections become folders, each page becomes a note with its original dates, To Do tags become native checklists, and tables, colors, images, files, audio, drawings and links between pages come along. No Microsoft login and nothing uploaded: everything runs on your Mac. $19, one-time.

records.name: ByteVoice

records.description: Talk to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any agent instead of typing, hear their summaries, and reply directly to agents.

records.name: Degla AI
records.tagline: Your intent. Onboard Autonomous Execution.
records.description: Degla AI builds autonomy software that enables drones to understand spoken instructions, reason onboard, and adapt as the mission unfolds. An operator can say, “Find the missing hiker wearing a red sweater.” The drone plans the mission, interprets what it sees, and adjusts its flight as new information emerges. The operator sets the objective and the aircraft handles the execution. Once you’ve expressed your intent, the system owns the problem.

records.name: Pharen Hub
records.tagline: One AI workspace for your whole company
records.description: Pharen Hub brings projects, tasks, docs, mail, meetings, data and AI agents into one workspace with one shared context. Agents work with clear goals, allowed sources and human approval. Hosted in the EU or on your own servers. Fair-code, source on GitHub. Free plan to start.

records.name: ChatGPT Wallet
records.tagline: Let ChatGPT agents buy things without seeing your card
records.description: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI's "dots" agents finish purchases for you. The card network gives the agent a payment token, so neither the agent nor the merchant ever sees your card number. You review the items, the total and the card before each purchase, then approve with Face ID or a fingerprint. Built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa.

records.name: StateWeave
records.tagline: Test your AI agent on working clones of the apps it uses
records.description: StateWeave runs your AI agent in sandboxes of the apps it works in: stateful clones of Slack, Gmail, Salesforce, Shopify, Zendesk, Google Calendar, Sheets, Drive, WhatsApp and Teams, with the same APIs, MCP servers and UIs as the real thing. Describe a scenario to fill every app with consistent data, inject faults like outages and 401s, and get graded runs showing which checks failed and the exact calls behind them. Fresh copy every run.

records.name: LingoMic
records.tagline: Speak your language in meetings, they hear theirs
records.description: LingoMic is a Chrome extension that translates your voice live in online meetings. Speak your own language and others hear the translation through a virtual microphone, in Google Meet, Zoom and Teams on the web. No bot joins the call. It also shows translated captions in 24 languages and writes AI notes with decisions and action items. Uses your own Gemini API key; a free key works. 30 minutes free, then plans from $29 for 6 months or $79 lifetime.

records.name: Cookie Away
records.tagline: Rejects cookie banners for you, even the sneaky ones
records.description: Cookie Away is a free, open-source Chrome extension that rejects cookie banners for you. No reject button? It opens the settings, switches everything off and saves. It never pays to say no, checks every click, and we published its results on 69 sites.

records.name: Trusty CSV

records.description: Data prep without the project, the flow or the script. Open a CSV and work on the file itself: cluster similar values, pivot, join, filter, or just type in a cell. Every step is one Ctrl+Z, and a diff of the saved file shows only what you changed.

records.name: Newsology

records.name: actup
records.tagline: An nvm-style version manager for GitHub Actions

Pin, sync, audit, and upgrade uses: refs fromactup.yaml, with breaking-change warnings and OSV.dev checks before anything writes. v0.10.0 adds actup mcp: a stdio Model Context Protocol server for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Copilot that exposes upgrades, pins, and audits as typed tools. records.description: VYBE.ART is an AI studio for art, games and interactive experiences. Render it to video, repaint it in any look with Perlin Paint, step inside it in VR or AR, then share a link anyone can play and remix. Start free with 150 tokens. Playing, remixing, sharing and exporting are always free.

records.name: Aden Data
records.tagline: Free AI-powered bandwidth manager for Android — no ads

records.name: Stashq
records.tagline: Sell digital products in India from your own store
records.description: Stashq gives Indian creators a standalone storefront at username.stashq.in to sell ebooks, study notes, Notion templates, presets, LUTs, audio packs, and code archives up to 64 GB. Buyers pay in INR via UPI or card as guests without creating an account and download right away. Stashq acts as merchant of record, buying each sale at wholesale and issuing the retail GST invoice to the buyer. Free to start (10 GB, 8% Stashq margin), scaling down to 0% on Pro

records.name: Hemle
records.tagline: AI tutor for your lectures, PDFs, YouTube and recordings
records.description: Turn your lectures, textbook chapters and slides into guided lessons with Malet, an AI tutor that cites the page or the minute behind each answer. Add a PDF, Word or PowerPoint file, a YouTube link, or a class you record. Generate quizzes and flashcards from the same source, then review with spaced repetition and track mastery. Free to try without a card, with paid Pro and Max plans. For adults 18+ in the US.

records.name: Creation4Creators AI
records.tagline: AI tools to create Image, Video, VoiceOvers , in one place
records.description: Creation4Creators AI helps turn ideas into better images and videos. Start with a rough idea, and we’ll help refine your prompt with details about style, lighting, and motion.

records.name: Win $2,900 in Amazon Gift Cards, Free
records.tagline: Last Hours: Win $2,900 in Amazon Gift Cards, Free
records.description: The giveaway closes December 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM UTC. Enter free for a chance to win $2,900 in Amazon gift cards.

records.name: Biosphere
records.tagline: Healthier Social Media
records.description: Biosphere is a completely revamped, renewed, and redefined social media. It doesn't beg for attention, doesn't constantly feed you dopamine traps, and doesn't have an algorithm. There is exceptional moderation on the website in order to keep our community safe. There is everything you would expect from a social media, and more distinct innovative features to come. Join us along for the ride!

records.name: Ghost Job Truth Filter
records.tagline: Spot ghost jobs before you waste an application
records.description: Ghost Job Truth Filter scores every job on LinkedIn and Indeed for ghost-job signals — reposted for months, 200+ applicants, stale promoted ads — and shows a 0-100 Truth Score right on the listing. It remembers every role you see, so a refreshed ghost can't erase its history, and reveals Indeed's hidden original posting date. Free: Truth Badges, hide ghost jobs, 5-stage application tracker. 100% private — everything stays in your browser, no account, no tracking.

records.name: Calyqen AI
records.tagline: Your AI job-search coach, from search to signed offer
records.description: Calyqen AI is an AI job-search coach, free during the beta. It matches you with jobs and scores the fit, tailors your resume to each one, runs mock interviews, and helps you rehearse the salary conversation. Caly writes only from your real experience and the sources it cites, and nothing is sent anywhere until you approve it. Built by Nikita Tejwani, a 17-year-old founder in San Antonio, Texas.

records.name: Anonymous
records.tagline: Read and share anonymous confessions, secrets, & stories
records.description: Anonymous is a platform where people can share their thoughts, confessions, secrets and personal stories without revealing their identity. Read real anonymous experiences, share your own confessions, explore relationship stories, secret crushes, family secrets, regrets and everyday thoughts, and connect with stories from people around the world.

records.name: Klang
records.tagline: Expressive music player for Android
records.description: Klang is a lightweight Android music player built with Material 3 Expressive. Synced lyrics, a 10-band EQ, My Mix shuffle, and Spotify and YouTube Music imports. Free and open source.

records.name: TALLIS
records.tagline: Private Messaging, Calls & VPN for iPhone
records.description: Tallis is a privacy-focused messenger for iOS and Android. It brings private chats, voice and video calls, groups, channels, and integrated VPN connectivity into one app. Built by Portugal-based NUN Analytics and Research, Tallis aims to give users more choice and control over how they communicate.

records.name: Scroll Pig
records.tagline: Lock distracting apps for free. Pay to unlock them early.
records.description: Scroll Pig is the only screen time app that shames you for your excessive phone use while using the friction of your hard-earned money as a consequence. Lock your apps for free for a minimum of an hour. Wanna unlock them before the timer's up? That'll cost you. Set a custom fee to create your own personalized penalty, unlock cute pig skins and climb the Loserboard the more you cave to your bad habits. There's finally a real cost to scrolling.

records.name: Waste Site Compliance OS
records.tagline: Track permit conditions, checks and EA visits in Notion
records.description: A Notion workspace for permitted waste sites in England. Track every permit condition, log checks, close out non-compliances and write your FPP and management plans. Overdue checks are flagged for you. 11 databases, 4 dashboards

records.name: Listfolk
records.tagline: Shared grocery and shopping list for iPhone
records.description: Someone always buys the milk twice. Listfolk gives you and the people you shop with one shared list. Add something on your phone and it shows up on theirs right away, and everyone can see who added what. It syncs through iCloud, so nobody has to sign up for anything. Sort the list by aisle and you stop walking back across the store for the bread you missed. Send an invite in Messages and you're shopping together.

records.name: Outfit Silhouette Guide
records.tagline: Find outfit silhouettes that suit your shape. No photo.
records.description: Free tool that finds the outfit silhouettes that balance your proportions from three measurements: bust, waist, and hips (shoulders optional). No photo, no upload, no sign-up. It compares ratios, not sizes, so the same shape gets the same advice at any size. You get named garment types to look for while shopping. Works in inches or centimetres. 2 free scans a day.

records.name: Brik Pro
records.tagline: Rental and property management software for French agencies
records.description: Brik Pro is the professional edition of Brik, the French rental management software by Brik.com, for real-estate agencies, property managers, landlords' companies, social housing and local authorities, 1 to 5,000+ units. Everything in Brik (leases, receipts, inventories, bank sync, pre-accounting, AI) plus third-party property management, multi-mandate handling and SEPA direct debit. On quote.

records.name: MacVisor
records.tagline: Run your Mac as a virtualization host
records.description: macOS, Windows 11, Linux and FreeBSD VMs setup automatically with account, SSH keys and guest tools: a MacBook becomes a dev box, a Mac mini or Studio a headless virtualization host you drive remotely, from the mvz CLI, or the built-in MCP server; run by a background service, with snapshots, networks and a firewall, scheduled backups, AI sandboxes, OCI images, VM auto-start and high availability, and other advanced features.

records.name: Image to Image AI - PictCraft
records.tagline: Image to image AI that changes one thing and keeps the rest
records.description: PictCraft is an image to image AI generator. Upload a photo, describe what should change, and it edits that one thing while keeping the rest: face, pose, framing. Swap a background, change an outfit, restyle a portrait, remove people or combine up to five images. 1K, 2K or 4K output, no watermark, and your photos are never used for training. Free to start with Google sign-in.

records.name: IQWY
records.tagline: Give your photos a why, a voice, and a story
records.description: Every photo has a story. IQWY helps you remember why you kept it. Add a “Why” to your photos, turn memories into stories narrated with your own voice, relive them, and share them as videos. IQWY also helps you keep screenshots, documents, and links for a reason. Find them when you need them, set reminders, and organize what matters. Your photos, personal notes, and voice recordings stay on your device. Available for iPhone and iPad. Free to use, with an optional subscription to remove ads.

records.name: Rainpath
records.tagline: Get more from every field by knowing where the water goes.
records.description: Rainpath shows where rain collects, the paths it flows along and where it leaves your field, so you can drain the right spots, plant where the soil stays moist and keep your topsoil in place. Tap or draw a field and it reads the terrain from public LiDAR. Set your soil and organic matter to see how much rain it soaks up before it flows away.

records.name: CMA'X'NEXUS
records.tagline: One audit for Google, AI answers & generative search
records.description: CMA'X'NEXUS is the website audit from CALL MATE AI. One audit across SEO, AEO and GEO — real Google PageSpeed data, a visual plain-English report, a step-by-step fix plan and a 30-day order of work.

records.name: Valmera
records.tagline: Edit footage by describing the cut you want
records.description: Give Valmera footage you already shot and describe the cut you want. Preview the first version, ask for a specific change, then export an MP4. For example, turn an interview into a vertical clip with captions, then ask for a different opening using the same footage. Work in Valmera Studio or connect a compatible AI assistant through MCP.

records.name: RentYard Finder
records.tagline: Find equipment rental yards near you, nationwide.
records.description: RentYard Finder is a free, nationwide directory of equipment rental yards. Search by city, state, or machine (mini excavators, skid steers, scissor and boom lifts, trenchers, and more), compare yards side by side, and see rental rates exactly as companies post them, with the source and date. Tools include a which-machine picker, a rental cost calculator, and a multi-yard quote request.

records.name: Great Again
records.tagline: Rediscover music, movies, and games by year
records.description: Pick a year and see what came out back then. Browse movies, music, games, books, and more, with details and sources for things you want to explore. Save finds to your shelf. Free to use, with no account needed to browse. Covers 1950–2025 in five-year steps.

records.name: Fewchurs
records.tagline: Feature requests and voting board for your app
records.description: Add a feature request board to your app in a few lines of code. Users suggest and vote without an account. Followers get an email when you ship.

records.name: Nexus
records.tagline: Make agents deploy your AI products faster for customers
records.description: Nexus is a self-learning context layer that helps forward deployed (FDE) teams move faster. It structures your deployment context into something proactive, adaptive, and that does all the work for you including codifying playbooks, surfacing and shipping product signal, taking high priority tasks, and highlighting repeatable work. This means agents take on your most complex FDE work and deliver it fast and reliably for customers.

records.name: Playframe Interactive
records.tagline: Playable ads for mobile games, built from your APK
records.description: We turn your game APK and creative brief into production-ready 2D and 3D playable ads, tested and delivered for your ad networks. Try our demo playables in the browser and request a free pilot.

records.name: Graphtia Explorer
records.tagline: Visual code intelligence for humans and AI agents
records.description: Explore your codebase as a local graph and give coding agents structural context through MCP. Trace supported symbols, calls, dependencies, APIs and declared database schemas back to source evidence. Inspect documents, assess change impact and control each agent's workspace access. Available for Windows and Ubuntu. Free: 100,000 code LOC per workspace and 2 workspaces per installation.

records.name: InvoiceCraft Pro
records.tagline: Offline PDF Invoice & Quote Generator (No Subscriptions)
records.description: Create studio-grade PDF invoices, quotes, and receipts in 60 seconds — 100% locally in your browser. Zero subscriptions, bilingual (EN/ES), multi-currency, automatic VAT/IVA & IRPF calculations, and local client/history memory.

records.name: Aifaceswap
records.tagline: Put a familiar face into photos, videos and GIFs
records.description: Try a different face in a favorite photo, clip or GIF without installing an editor. Aifaceswap works in your browser, lets you choose one to four people to swap, and offers 10 free credits every day. Start without an account and download watermark-free results. Use only media and faces you have permission to use.

records.name: StoryTime
records.tagline: Bedtime stories for kids, told in your own voice
records.description: StoryTime turns bedtime stories into narrations read in the voices your family loves — Mom's, Dad's, or your own. StoryTime turns a parent’s recorded voice into brand-new bedtime stories for kids. Record once, pick a category and mood, and your child hears a fresh story in your voice every night, in Telugu, Hindi, English, Marathi and more. Now live in India on Android.

records.name: Farside Research
records.tagline: Deep research you can check, in the app, API or MCP
records.description: Ask a hard question and Farside searches in rounds, grades the sources and writes a cited answer. Every claim links to the passage behind it, open gaps stay visible, and Deep runs chase the loose threads. Use it in the web app, REST API or MCP.

records.name: Pickin’ Folk
records.tagline: Find and host bluegrass, old-time and folk jams near you
records.description: Every picker knows the conversation: "We should get together and play sometime."..and then nobody does. Pickin' Folk turns "sometime" into "Saturday at 7." Find bluegrass, old-time and folk jams near you on a map, RSVP with the instrument you're bringing, or host your own in minutes, with the pace and level spelled out so first-timers know what to expect. Weekly jams schedule themselves, and exact addresses stay private until you're going. Free on iPhone, Android and the web.

records.name: Intelligent Eyewear
records.tagline: Samsung and Google bring Gemini AI to smart eyewear
records.description: Samsung Intelligent Eyewear brings Google Gemini into lightweight smart glasses designed with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker. Ask questions about what you see, translate menus, navigate with Google Maps, capture photos and videos, and manage messages hands-free. Featuring a 12MP camera, open-ear audio, up to 9 hours of battery life, and 30 design variations. Preorders are open in the U.S., starting at $395, with availability beginning December 10.

records.name: ThinkQuarry Free Online Tools
records.tagline: Free PDF, image, math and business tools
records.description: A growing collection of practical online utilities from ThinkQuarry. Convert PDF pages to JPG, resize and compress images, solve equations, calculate percentage changes and slope, estimate customer lifetime value, and track business income and expenses. Free to use, with direct links to each tool.

records.name: Oraculum
records.tagline: Autonomous Quantitative Research Platform
records.description: Discover, backtest, validate, and continuously improve trading strategies through closed-loop optimization.

records.name: Tatmorph AI Tattoo Generator
records.tagline: AI tattoo designs with real rotatable 3D body preview
records.description: AI tattoo generator tuned for tattoo art, with a real rotatable 3D body preview. Describe your idea (or upload a reference), pick a style, and get a clean, stencil-ready design in about a minute — high-contrast linework on a plain white background. Then place it on a real 3D body model. Rotate freely, move, resize, switch male/female bodies and skin tones, and see how the design follows actual body curves — not a flat mockup or photo overlay.

records.name: Equinox
records.tagline: Find the Right editor in as little as 10 min
records.description: Equinox is an AI-powered global editor discovery platform that connects creators, businesses, and video editors worldwide. Using advanced AI, Equinox helps users discover editors based on their project requirements, explore portfolios, compare skills and styles, and connect directly with the right creative talent — all in one place.

records.name: Glifa
records.tagline: The Markdown editor for Mac you can ask for anything
records.description: Glifa is a Mac Markdown editor with the AI inside the document. Select text, press ⇧⌘R and type what you need, like "turn these notes into a table" or "make this sound less like a robot wrote it". There are also 18 built-in actions. It works with Claude Code or Codex on your plan, Apple Intelligence, a local model or your own key. The editor has live preview, math, Mermaid and Obsidian vaults. 15-day free trial.

records.name: Peekrow
records.tagline: Click a customer to see their orders, no SQL needed
records.description: Peekrow lets you look through connected data by clicking instead of writing SQL. In the free browser demo (no signup), click a customer to see their orders, then an order to see its items. Search, sort, filter, and edit with undo. You can also open your ownxlsx,xls orcsv, and the file stays in your browser. Optional AI helper: free with your own OpenAI or OpenRouter key, or US$4.99/month hosted. Desktop apps are coming; SQLite database files already open. Feedback very welcome.

records.name: Sigma Wallet
records.tagline: Deploy your ERC20 vault, no single key controls
records.description: Sigma Wallet is a purpose-built factory for deploying non-custodial multisig vaults on Polygon. Create a vault with clear roles and a straightforward deploy flow—built for shared funds, not another generic wallet UI. Early access: the first 100 successful deploys can enter promo code FIRST100 for a 13.90 USDT deploy fee (instead of 189 USDT). The first 100 wallets are also eligible for a random airdrop based on usage.

records.name: ZoroPrint
records.tagline: DTF RIP for Epson printers on Mac, Windows and Linux
records.description: ZoroPrint is a DTF RIP that talks to converted Epson printers directly: no driver, no dongle. It builds the white underbase with choke, nests the gang sheet, flags halo risks before you print and shows the cost per transfer. Runs on Mac, Windows and Linux, plus a browser Studio. Free for one printer, no watermark.

records.name: FLOW
records.tagline: Legal instruction streams for any CPU — no ISA hard-coded
records.description: Framework for Instruction Orchestration & Workflows (FLOW) 🔑 Key ideas: • ISA-agnostic: no mnemonics, registers, or encodings hard-coded • Change the ISA, keep the script — intent survives arch changes • Four integration tiers — from YAML-only to full C++ plugin; start at the tier your ISA needs • Seed-reproducible — identical output across machines and CI • MIT SDK — your plugin is entirely your own work For Virtual Prototyping & SoC Platform Dev, Perf Arch, ISA designers, CPU/Verification Engr

records.name: CompressKit
records.tagline: Compress files in your browser — nothing is uploaded
records.description: CompressKit compresses PDFs, images, video, archives and Office documents entirely in your browser using WebAssembly. There is no upload step: your files never leave your device. 27 file types, no account needed for one file, and a $2 one-time option for unlimited use.

records.name: POSPal
records.tagline: Restaurant ordering software without the complexity
records.description: Download, install and start taking orders. POSPal makes restaurant order management accessible without sales calls, expensive hardware or complicated installations. Get wireless ordering, table management, kitchen workflows and digital QR menus in one affordable subscription. Built-in guided onboarding lets you get started independently. Try everything free for 30 days, with no account registration or payment details required.

records.name: The 25/8
records.tagline: Share real stories, anonymously or openly.
records.description: The 25/8 is a social storytelling platform where real-life experiences, relationship dilemmas, confessions, and everyday stories find a place. Explore stories, discover different perspectives, join conversations, and share your own experiences- anonymously or openly. Whether you have something to get off your chest, a dilemma you'd love opinions on, or simply enjoy reading real stories, there's always something to discover. Real stories. New perspectives. Always a story. Always someone.

records.name: AeroWalk
records.tagline: breathe good air when you go out for walks
records.description: Aerowalk is a lightweight web app that turns every stroll into a health‑focused experience. It visualises real‑time air‑quality data along your route, highlights clean‑air pathways, and gives you a simple “walk‑score” based on pollution levels, distance, and duration. Live AQI overlay – see the current Air Quality Index for every street segment. Smart routing – the app suggests the freshest routes automatically, or you can pick your own path and see the AQI impact instantly.

records.name: Rootling
records.tagline: Kids abroad learn to talk to grandma in her language
records.description: Personalised 5-minute lessons, stories and games that help children aged 3–10 speak Tamil, Telugu, Punjabi, Gujarati or Malayalam. Each lesson ends with "Tap and say it": a real line to say to Paati on the next video call. No ads, parent-owned accounts.

records.name: Lịch Nước
records.tagline: Lịch thủy triều hôm nay cho từng điểm ven biển
records.description: Lịch Nước (lichnuoc.com) giúp bạn xem giờ nước lên, nước ròng và độ cao thủy triều tại các điểm ven biển Việt Nam. Bạn có thể chọn ngày nước cường, xem giờ câu cá đẹp, theo dõi biểu đồ thủy triều và tải lịch về điện thoại. Trang còn có giờ bình minh, hoàng hôn và giờ vàng tại các tỉnh, thành cùng nhiều điểm săn mây, giúp bạn chọn thời gian đi biển, câu cá và chụp ảnh.

records.name: Ticketpal
records.tagline: One shared place for your family's travel tickets
records.description: One shared place for your family's travel tickets and bookings. Ask Claude or ChatGPT to sync in your trips, then open your shared travel plans on your phone. No need to forward booking emails! Our MCP connection means you can provide Claude/ChatGPT with context about all your family's travel plans or book stuff via other connectors (Uber; Booking.com...) Free for now, with planned pricing at $20 per year for a family of four, so 50% cheaper than our closest peers.

records.name: Nurture: Plant Care App
records.tagline: The plant care app that doesn't paywall the basics, for real
records.description: Most plant apps paywall the basics. Nurture doesn't. Free, with unlimited plants: reminders for watering, fertilizing, repotting or any task you make up, all due at once in one notification; schedules that ease off in winter; a care guide for every plant; plant ID from a photo, 3 a month; a care history with photos. A small ad keeps it free. For heavy users, Premium removes ads and adds more IDs, plant diagnosis and backup; the Household plan shares your plants with family or a plant sitter.

records.name: JSLab
records.tagline: Write code. Watch it run as you type.
records.description: JSLab is a fast, native JavaScript and TypeScript scratchpad for macOS. Write code, watch it run as you type, and read every result beside the line that produced it. No project, no build step, no telemetry. Apple Silicon. A runaway loop never kills the editor.

records.name: Musicoo
records.tagline: Short videos where every creator can monetize
records.description: Musicoo is a short-video social platform where anyone can create, share and monetize exclusive content without a minimum follower requirement. Creators can offer premium videos through in-app credits and request withdrawals starting at €5, subject to payout eligibility. Musicoo charges a 5% platform fee on the amount remaining after applicable app store fees. Join our growing community of creators!

records.name: Cliedesk
records.tagline: An AI help desk that runs inside your WordPress admin
records.description: Cliedesk is a complete help desk built as a WordPress plugin: shared inbox, live chat, help center and customer portal in one place. An AI agent answers customers and can act on their WooCommerce orders, while a copilot drafts every reply for your team. It's for WordPress and WooCommerce stores that don't want support data living in another SaaS: tickets stay in your own database, and the AI runs on your own API key.

records.name: Notebook to Notes
records.tagline: Move your OneNote notebooks to Apple Notes, 100% offline
records.description: Move your Microsoft OneNote notebooks to Apple Notes on your Mac. Download them from OneDrive, drop thezip in the app and click Import. Sections become folders, each page becomes a note with its original dates, To Do tags become native checklists, and tables, colors, images, files, audio, drawings and links between pages come along. No Microsoft login and nothing uploaded: everything runs on your Mac. $19, one-time.

records.name: Chismecito
records.tagline: Consigue amigos, familia y pareja te esperamos en CHISMECITO
records.description: Welcome to Chismecito! ❤️ There's always someone to talk to, something to share, or an adventure to discover here. Chismecito is a place to meet people, make friends, find companionship, and have a good time. You can come in to chat, share what you're doing, play games, or simply hang out with people from all over. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Your Own Family On Chismecito, you can create your own family, find partners, connect with other users, and build your own family tree. Every story is different!

records.name: Grok X-Report Engine
records.tagline: Turn 3-hour X monthly reports into 10-minute insights.
records.description: Stop wasting 20+ hours a month manually building X reports. Turn raw X Analytics data into consultant-grade client reports in 10 minutes using Grok's real-time platform intelligence. Master Analyst Prompt: Extracts growth factors, bottlenecks & next-month action plans. Zero-Math-Error Templates: Markdown input blueprints prevent AI hallucinations. Algorithm & Sentiment Add-ons: Deep-dives into X trends & audience feedback.

records.name: Ank
records.tagline: A Mac notepad where every line is a calculation
records.description: Type a line the way you'd write it, like "rent = ₹28,000" or "15% off $598.50", and the answer sits beside it. Change one number and everything that depends on it updates. Live currencies, units, dates, EMI and SIP, lakh and crore, and plain-English questions answered by Apple Intelligence on your Mac. No account, no tracking; sheets are plain text files.

records.name: RemoveFree
records.tagline: Free local AI background remover - HD PNG, no signup
records.description: With standalone remove.bg closing on Dec 1, 2026 into Canva, RemoveFree is a free, standalone web alternative that removes backgrounds 100% locally in your browser using WebGPU & WebAssembly. Zero image bytes leave your device. Exports original W×H transparent PNG & WebP (no 0.25 MP cap, no watermarks, no account), plus 1:1 e-commerce square, Batch ZIP, Erase/Restore brushes, Portrait Mode, and opt-in Studio HD across 6 languages (EN, FR, ES, PT, ID, AR).

records.name: Weeksafe
records.tagline: Know what's safe to spend this week, on irregular income
records.description: Freelance income arrives unevenly. Weeksafe holds back tax and upcoming bills, then shows one number you can spend this week. Paste Indian bank SMS or import a CSV, no bank login. Free plan, no card. Pro adds tax rules for India, UK and US.

records.name: Nestpeep
records.tagline: Link-in-bio page with URL checks, undo and link scheduling
records.description: A link-in-bio page with a safety net. Every link is checked so broken URLs never reach your followers, undo covers your last 20 actions, links can be scheduled, and analytics explain themselves. Free forever, no card; Plus adds your own domain.

records.name: Lunonis
records.tagline: Your birth chart, written into a personal astrology book
records.description: Calculate your natal chart for free, in 11 languages: every planet, house and aspect for your exact birth time and place, checked against Swiss Ephemeris. Then, if you like it, get a personal book or a monthly forecast written from that chart. The texts are AI-assisted and we say so. For reflection, not prediction.

records.name: Shiplist
records.tagline: Submit to 100 launch directories without retyping
records.description: Launching means typing the same name, tagline, description and link into dozens of directory forms. Shiplist takes the retyping out. Save your product details once, then go through 100 launch directories one by one: it opens each submit page and puts every field one click from your clipboard. It tracks what's submitted and live, and tags your link per directory. It doesn't auto-submit. Free, no signup, your details stay in your browser.

records.name: Anchor
records.tagline: Anchor before you scroll
records.description: Anchor is a free Christian discipline app for men who want God first, a strong body and a clear head. Each day you get a short guided prayer, one verse and one action, built around the battle you name: lust, anxiety, anger, laziness, money stress or the scroll. Keep a streak (a freeze covers one bad day), follow a 30-day path, log gym days, run a phone-down focus timer, and ask questions of Ask Anchor, an AI guide that checks every verse it cites against the real Bible text.

records.name: DriveApp: Private Storage
records.tagline: Encrypted S3 photos & drive
records.description: Your photos. Your files. Your cloud. Not theirs. DriveApp is a focused drive backup app for people who want the comfort of a photo library and a file drawer just like in the cloud, without giving their library to a big tech account. Connect your own private S3 storage, enable client-side encryption, and back up from your phone. Browse everything from one place in peace. Why people choose DriveApp Built for everyday use Open Photos to back up memories. Open Drive to drop in a PDF or zip.

records.name: Stock Meadow
records.tagline: Stock scoring models you can see inside, tune and backtest

Change the weights and filters, then backtest your model on up to 20 years of history. records.name: ByteVoice

records.description: Talk to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any agent instead of typing, hear their summaries, and reply directly to agents.

records.name: Degla AI
