records.description: Editor de PDF privado que funciona 100% en el navegador. Edita, firma y anota sin subir archivos a ningún servidor.

records.name: ByteMap
records.tagline: Desktop Storage Intelligence
records.description: See where your disk space actually went. Built with native Rust, BLAKE3 deduplication, and vibrant pop-art visualization.

records.name: NEXUS AI 100
records.tagline: AI Antivirus & 100 Free AI Tools
records.description: Free AI Antivirus Fake Link Detector and directory of 100 free AI tools for text, image, video, voice, and coding.

records.name: Ribbon
records.tagline: Scroll your windows instead of shrinking them
records.description: Ribbon is a scrolling window manager for Mac. Windows stay full height on one horizontal strip. A new app opens beside the one you are using; the others keep the size you left them. Swipe with three fingers, set widths, stack apps in a column. Accessibility only — SIP stays on. Pay once for 1, 3, or 5 Macs. macOS 14+ on Apple silicon.

records.name: ClipClip
records.tagline: Grow your Roblox game.
records.description: The all-in-one marketing platform for Roblox games: clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, thumbnails, the page video, Roblox ads and analytics.

records.name: Rupela.in Pro
records.tagline: Ultimate accounting, POS, and inventory powerhouse
records.description: Integrated cloud accounting software featuring thermal/A4 POS billing, barcode scanner support, multi-godown inventory control, automated GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B tax filing, and statutory compliance calendars.

records.name: Anonym Browser
records.tagline: anti-detect browser for multi-account work
records.description: Anonym Browser helps teams manage multiple browser profiles securely.

records.name: Invitely
records.tagline: Invites and greetings for any occasion, sent as one link
records.description: Make an invitation page for any event, from birthdays and weddings to dinners and office parties, and share it as one link in any chat. Guests open it in any browser and reply in two taps, with no app and no account. Live guest list, reminders, photo covers and greeting cards. Free up to 50 guests. Christmas covers are out now.

records.name: Descant
records.tagline: Your zero-config software factory
records.description: Descant is your zero-config software factory. It merged 14,647 pull requests building itself, with 5 reverted. Its next frontier is proving software: first-ever try at Lean autonomously built an open-source Unicode segmentation library, complete with proofs Lean checked, in one shot. Within Descant, different models challenge each other through structured contracts and evidence-backed correctness checks. Zero-config, zero-trust cloud environments. Costs tracked per piece of work down to the cent

records.name: Plinth
records.tagline: Indie iOS apps worth keeping, each picked by a person
records.description: Plinth is a curated home for indie iOS apps. Every app in the index was read by a person before it went in. Featured picks get an issue of their own, with the reason for the pick written out, a cover printed in the colors of the app's icon, and a direct link to the App Store. 85 apps from 63 developers so far. Developers submit for free and get a real answer: yes, no, or a question. Nobody can pay to get picked. One sponsored spot a week is labeled and kept apart from the picks.

records.name: CalDesk AI
records.tagline: Free barcode and photo calorie tracking, no ads
records.description: CalDesk is a calorie and macro tracker. Snap a photo of your plate for an AI calorie and macro estimate, or scan a barcode for instant nutrition facts plus a health and eco score. Free tier: unlimited manual, barcode and text logging, no ads, and 5 AI photo scans a day. Search 400,000+ USDA foods, track streaks, weight and macros, and see a daily nutrition score that flags what to fix. Pro adds unlimited AI photo scans, AI meal plans, and an adjusting calorie goal. iPhone and Android.

records.name: ogdynamic
records.tagline: Personalized OG, social & email images from a URL
records.description: ogdynamic is a canvas editor and URL-based image generator for personalized visuals at any scale. Design a template once on a free-form canvas, mark layers as overridable, and generate OG images, social banners, blog covers, and product images from query parameters — no SDK required. The in-browser preview runs the same Rust rendering engine as the server, so what you design is exactly what renders. Ships with 86 templates and an MCP server for AI-native image design.

records.name: Dictate Safe
records.tagline: Dictation for Mac and Windows that runs on your computer
records.description: Hold a key, speak, and Dictate Safe types your words into whatever app you are using, on Mac or Windows. Speech is turned into text on your own computer by default, and you need no account to dictate. It has Code Mode for dictating symbols, a prompt library you search from a floating icon, and Keep Awake for long tasks. English only. One payment, no subscription. 25 free dictations, no account and no card.

records.name: count.live
records.tagline: Live countdowns you can share, embed, and keep on your phone
records.description: count.live makes a live countdown to any date in seconds: a trip, a wedding, a launch, Christmas. Every countdown is just a link that opens in any browser, so it keeps ticking in a group chat, a Canva slide, a Notion page or OBS. Pick a look, a ready-made picture or your own photo. The free iPhone and Android apps put your countdowns on your home screen as widgets. No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: WeConnect
records.tagline: Enterprise operating platform for people and AI
records.description: WeConnect is one portal for HR, payroll, recruitment, learning, projects, sales, accounting and inventory, on one shared data layer. People and AI agents work side by side, governed by roles. A built-in copilot and one MCP connector let Claude or any assistant work across every department. Indian payroll (PF, ESI, TDS) and GST accounting are included.

records.name: Radiant Path Therapy and Psychiatry
records.tagline: Mental Health Care That Creates Lasting Change
records.description: Psychiatric care in Southern California with licensed psychiatric providers who help you feel better through careful evaluation and ongoing care, in person in Redlands, Grand Terrace and Corona or online through telepsychiatry.

records.name: DuckGPU
records.tagline: $1.29/hour. Pay for time, not per generation.
records.description: AI images, videos & chat in your browser for $1.29/hour, billed by the second. Pay for time, not per generation. With continuous generation, MiniMax H3 Turbo 768p costs approximately $0.0056 per second of generated video (~$0.028 for a 5-second clip). Estimate excludes startup and idle time. No local GPU or setup needed. 5 GB storage included.

records.name: Webdesly Salon
records.tagline: Private collections and appointments for luxury boutiques
records.description: Quiet invitation desk for luxury boutiques and maisons: curated private collections, client wishlists, and appointment requests to confirm or complete on a Today desk. Not an open catalog, not a full CRM. Free client portal and staff demo, no signup.

records.name: Vigilbase OS
records.tagline: AI security for everyone, even with no security team
records.description: Attackers now use AI, and you shouldn't need a security team to keep up. Vigilbase OS plugs into the tools you already use. Vigil, our AI agent, reads every alert, tells you in plain words which ones need you, and has the fix ready to approve. Free to start.

records.name: Footnote
records.tagline: Design an email signature. Share it as a team template.
records.description: Edit your name and title right in the email preview, then choose fonts and colors. Copy your signature into your email settings, or share a template link so teammates can keep the design and add their own details. Free to use without an account.

records.name: Substack Radar MCP
records.tagline: Substack sponsors & creator emails in Claude & Cursor
records.description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server for finding Substack newsletters, active sponsorship slots, and verified creator outreach emails directly in Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client. Connect https://substack-radar-mcp.netlify.app/mcp with zero local scrapers or setup. Unlimited access via Whop ($19/mo) or pay-per-call via x402 ($0.05 USDC on Base).

records.name: Clifzo
records.tagline: Save videos, audio, and images right from the page
records.description: Clifzo automatically finds media loaded on the page. Open the Chrome or Edge extension to pick what to save, then download it to your device. It can merge compatible video and audio tracks locally. Have a link? Paste it on clifzo.com.

records.name: Archseed
records.tagline: Plan the work before your coding agent writes it
records.description: Archseed is a CLI-first workflow for defining V1 scope, non-goals, and guardrails before you ask Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or another coding agent to implement. Start from one short project description, confirm the few decisions that matter, and get a reviewable project contract your coding agent can follow.

records.name: TenFold
records.tagline: Turn one podcast episode into a week of posts
records.description: Paste a YouTube, Spotify or Apple Podcasts link, or a transcript, and TenFold writes a blog post, X thread, LinkedIn post, Instagram caption, newsletter and 5 clip ideas in your voice, in about a minute. Save a note about how you sound once and every post follows it. Share the finished posts with a client in one private link. Free: 3 episodes a month. Pro: £15 a month, unlimited.

records.name: Pinscope
records.tagline: See inside every device you ship, in under 10 KB of RAM
records.description: Remote access, logs, crash reports and OTA updates for ESP32, plus Zephyr, Pico, Linux and ESP8266 in beta. One outbound connection, no open ports. Keeps each build's SBOM and watches it for new CVEs, for the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Free for 3 devices.

records.name: Hinata
records.tagline: Focused project & sprint management without the bloat
records.description: Ever spend more time updating tickets than actually building? Your project tool should keep momentum high, not bury you in 20-field forms. Hinata focuses on the 3 things small teams actually use: • Backlog: Dump ideas & bugs in seconds, zero clutter. • Sprints: Pick what ships this cycle with clear dates & goals. • Board: Watch work move live across columns & team swimlanes. Made for fast-moving teams up to 10, with instant search, checklists, comments, and weekly digests.

records.name: Neighbster
records.tagline: Post a job at your price, or claim jobs near you
records.description: Anything your neighbors can do for you, on demand. You set the price. Post a job like raking leaves, mowing, cleaning gutters, or moving furniture, name what you'll pay, and someone nearby claims it. They send photo proof when the work is done, and payment runs through Stripe, so nobody chases anybody for cash. The map shows a rough area, never your exact address. Want to earn instead? Open the map, claim jobs near you, and get paid. On iOS, Android and Web.

records.name: JetMotionAI
records.tagline: AI video generator for faceless YouTube channels
records.description: JetMotion turns a topic or script into a finished faceless YouTube video: narration, real footage, captions, motion graphics, music, an AI thumbnail, title, description and tags, plus matching Shorts. Paste your channel link and it plans your next 25 days from what already works. On Pro, Autopilot checks your channel and competitors every day, follows the videos taking off and makes each upload ahead of time. Start free with one 5-minute video, no card needed.

records.name: WorkedStats
records.tagline: Statistics calculators that show the work.
records.description: Most statistics calculators return one number. WorkedStats keeps the working visible: sorted data, the formula substitution, the row-by-row deviation squares, and the three quartile conventions courses use. Paste a dataset once, then move between median, mean, standard deviation, average, IQR and z-score without retyping it. Everything runs in the browser: no upload, no account, no chart library. Try it: https://workedstats.com/

records.name: Switch
records.tagline: Every Claude Desktop account, signed in at once on your Mac
records.description: Switch keeps your work, personal and client Claude accounts signed in side by side on your Mac. Each profile opens Anthropic's own Claude Desktop app, unmodified, with its own sign-in, colored Dock icon and global shortcut. One click tiles every open account. Share MCP servers, skills and plugins across profiles while sign-ins stay separate. Native SwiftUI app, no telemetry, never reads your chats.

records.name: SecretBar — Agent-safe secrets for Mac
records.tagline: Your agent knows the name. Never the value.
records.description: SecretBar is a free, open-source Mac app and command line tool that keeps secrets safe from AI agents. Passwords, tokens and API keys live in the Secure Enclave. The agent asks for a secret by name, you type it in a hidden macOS dialog, and the value goes only into the process that needs it. Output comes back masked as ***. Touch ID to read, post-quantum encryption, a Claude Code hook, time-boxed leases for unattended agents, Spotlight and Siri search. No cloud, no dependencies.

records.name: The Startup Idea Killer
records.tagline: Test your startup idea before wasting months building it.
records.description: Stop wasting months building a startup nobody wants. The Startup Idea Killer helps you figure out whether your business idea is worth pursuing before investing your time and money. Identify risky assumptions, run real-world validation experiments, and track evidence to earn your **Build Permission Slip** — a clear recommendation to build, test further, or rethink. Less guessing. More evidence. Better decisions. $19 · One-time purchase

records.name: Linkmotion.io
records.tagline: Turn your website into a launch video you can edit
records.description: Turn your website into an editable launch video. Paste a URL, choose your style, and add AI narration, music and sound effects. Refine the visuals with AI editing, then export. Built for business owners, founders and small teams.

records.name: Construction Business Management ERP
records.tagline: ERP made simple for modern businesses
records.description: Best is a Project Management Consultancy System for contracting firms: customers, estimates and quotations, projects with their stages, running bills and GST invoices, receipts and expenses, suppliers and purchase bills - with Human Resource (attendance, payroll, documents), Accounting (vouchers, ledgers, day book, bank books, year-end) and Collaboration (chat, meetings, support) in the same program and the same database.

records.name: BloatBuster
records.tagline: Reclaim gigabytes of build artifacts on your Mac, offline
records.description: BloatBuster finds the build output piling up across your projects (node_modules, target,gradle and more, across 17 project types), shows how much has gone stale, and gives you the command that rebuilds anything it removes. It also clears Xcode's DerivedData, old device support and developer caches like npm, pnpm, Cargo and Homebrew. Everything goes to the Trash. No network, no account, no telemetry. $2.99 once on the Mac App Store.

records.name: Lpdfi Watermark
records.tagline: Add a text or logo watermark that is hard to crop out
records.description: Protect photos before you share them. Add your name, shop name or logo, set the colour, size and opacity, and place it in a corner, repeat it across the whole photo, or use Shield: the mark at random angles and colours with fine lines, much harder to remove. Watermark all your photos in one tap; full size and format are kept. Runs in your browser: nothing is uploaded, no sign-up. Formerly LovePDFi.

records.name: YoCareerAI
records.tagline: Upload your CV once. AI applies to jobs for you.
records.description: YoCareerAI finds jobs that match you every day, tailors your CV and cover letter to each one, applies for you and tracks every reply. You can watch the AI fill in each employer's form live. When a form asks for something it does not know, it asks you once and remembers, instead of making it up. Agents also search the web for open jobs, for people worth contacting, and for scholarships and grants. 7-day free trial.

records.name: Voice Isolator
records.tagline: Isolate the voice in any video or song. Try free, no sign-up
records.description: Upload a video or audio file and get the voice and the background (music or noise) as separate tracks. Videos come back as the same video with only the voice; audio comes back as MP3, WAV or FLAC. Switch between original, voice and background in one player at the same moment. Try it free: 1 file a day (up to 10 min), no sign-up, full-quality download. Background is noise? Re-run in noise mode. Credit packs from $2.99 never expire.

records.name: Art Widget: Artwork of the Day
records.tagline: Your home screen, now a museum wall
records.description: An Android widget that puts one of the world's well-known works of art on your home screen, and on your lock screen where your phone allows it, with a new one every day. Tap it to see the work's title, artist, year and museum, and read its Wikipedia article right in the app. More than 9,000 works from hundreds of museums, every image freely licensed from Wikimedia Commons, in 11 languages. Free with one small ad; a one-time purchase removes it and adds sculptures, tapestries and a screensaver.

records.name: Lanyard
records.tagline: A teammate's dev stack, on your localhost
records.description: Lanyard is a Mac menu-bar app that puts another Mac's dev ports on your localhost. Pair two Macs once with a 6-digit code, share Postgres, Redis, a dev server or any TCP port, and the other Mac connects to localhost:5432 as if it ran there. Import a compose file to share a whole project, choose which Macs can use each port and for how long, and see who's connected. Encrypted, local network only, no account and no server. Free.

records.name: Audiout
records.tagline: Play your Mac's audio on every speaker in the house
records.description: Outside Apple's Music and TV apps, a Mac plays to one speaker at a time. Audiout plays to every speaker your Mac can reach, AirPlay, Bluetooth and Chromecast, all at once. Bluetooth speakers keep their own time, so Audiout lines them up with the rest and keeps them in sync. Send each app to its own speakers: Spotify in the kitchen, Zoom at your desk. Audiout Remote, included with Audiout for Mac, puts the same controls on your iPhone. €24.99 once, 14-day free trial.

records.name: Influencer Marketplace Next.js Template
records.tagline: Full source code for a creator marketplace you host yourself
records.description: Flumarq is the full Next.js + TypeScript source code of an influencer marketplace: creator storefronts, brand briefs, proposals, a shared workspace and an admin panel. SQLite or PostgreSQL, English and Turkish. You host and rebrand it. Not a hosted service.

records.name: Kllivo Commerce
records.tagline: Sell physical and digital products online, 0% commission
records.description: Kllivo Commerce lets small shops and creators sell online from their own store: physical products with stock, ebooks and digital downloads, couriers, discount codes, 4 languages and your own domain. 0% commission.

records.name: SweepPicks
records.tagline: AI that reads the fine print of sweepstakes promotions
records.description: SweepPicks is an AI assistant that reads the rules of sweepstakes and social gaming promotions so you don't have to. Ask in plain English, like which offers are open in your state or what a promotion really requires, and get an answer built only from the operators' own published rules. The AI understands your question; it never invents a number. It also flags where the marketing and the fine print disagree. Free, 18+, nothing to buy.

records.name: YumeComic
records.tagline: Turn one sentence into a full comic or manga episode
records.description: YumeComic turns a story idea into finished comic pages. Type a few sentences, pick one of 31 art styles (manga, manhwa, webtoon, superhero, storybook, noir) and get pages with panels, speech bubbles and captions in about a minute. Up to 4 characters stay the same across a 12-page story, from a description or a photo. Dialogue in 30 languages, PNG downloads with no watermark, and voiced comic videos in the app. On the web, iPhone and Android. Your first page is free.

records.name: Habakkuk
records.tagline: Your own AI agent in WhatsApp that asks before it acts
records.description: Habakkuk is an open-source AI agent you run on your own machine and talk to in WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack or 24 other chat apps. It sends your 8am brief, fixes the failing test and tells you the garage is still open at 11. Before anything risky, it asks you in the chat. Every job is saved first, so a crash doesn't lose it. Use Claude, GPT, Gemini or a local model. One program, free, Apache 2.0.

records.name: TRA-Copilot
records.tagline: Automate your TRA with AI Agents
records.description: AI agents read your solution documentation, extract relevant information, analyze assets, threats, and vulnerabilities, identify risks, and generate a Word report. You review, edit, and approve every step, maintaining full control throughout the process.

records.name: Toolsfolio
records.tagline: Privacy-first iPhone tools for PDFs, photos and invoices
records.description: Toolsfolio is a privacy-first toolbox for iPhone: 50+ everyday tools that run entirely on your device, so your files are never uploaded anywhere. Scan, edit, sign and compress PDFs. Make invoices, quotes and receipts. Convert, resize and cut out photos, and make QR codes. Even the smart tools, like Chat with PDF, use Apple's on-device model. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, and it works offline. Built for iPhone Duo too. Most tools are free; Pro unlocks 21 more.

records.name: Karma Atlas
records.tagline: Discover your past and next-life creatures in 19 questions
records.description: What if your personality had a past life? Karma Atlas turns 19 confession-style questions about ambition, ego, envy, and loyalty into a fictional creature reading. Discover your symbolic past and next lives, collect illustrated creature cards, explore your personality, and challenge friends to compare their results. A little dark. A little divine. Entirely for fun.

records.name: DeclutterMac
records.tagline: Clears junk files and frees up storage space on your Mac.
records.description: Problem it solves Macs fill up quietly with caches, old downloads, leftover app files and big forgotten files. Then you get the “storage almost full” warning, and macOS doesn’t show clearly what’s taking the space or what’s safe to delete. Who it’s for Mac users with limited storage, like students and professionals on base-model MacBooks. They want their space back without digging through Finder or paying for heavy all-in-one cleaner suites.

records.name: NIA
records.tagline: Your AI trip planner, anywhere in the world
records.description: NIA is your AI travel assistant. Tell it where you're headed, anywhere in the world, in your own words: dates, budget, pets, parking. NIA finds and books your stay, lines up flights, things to do and a rental car, and builds a day-by-day plan you can share. Hotels, flights and cars worldwide, priced in your own currency. Free to use.

records.name: Lynko
records.tagline: NFC business cards with a digital profile and analytics
records.description: UK-based premium NFC business cards with a beautiful digital profile, QR sharing, and real-time analytics.

records.name: CSS Carousel Examples
records.tagline: 60 CSS carousels, from 3D spirals to infinite loops, to copy
records.description: Browse 60 carousels you can copy: a 3D tornado, helix and double helix, Möbius ring, panorama, infinite marquees, scroll snap, coverflow, parallax, drag-to-swipe stacks and more. Open any card to see a large live preview, change the card count, speed or radius, and copy the HTML and CSS in one click. Most of them run on CSS alone; the ones that need JavaScript are marked JS and include a short, plain snippet. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Parchi.Invoices
records.tagline: Turn WhatsApp orders into GST invoices in seconds
records.description: Small sellers in India take orders on WhatsApp and Instagram, then type every invoice by hand. Parchi fixes that. Paste the customer's message, even in Hinglish, and get a GST-ready invoice with CGST/SGST/IGST worked out, HSN codes and a UPI QR. Send the PDF straight back on WhatsApp. Built for Instagram resellers and small D2C brands. 30-day passes from ₹249, no auto-renewal.

records.name: BridgeAAC
records.tagline: A free, open-source AAC app that works offline
records.description: BridgeAAC is a free communication app for people who can't rely on speech. Tap pictures to build a sentence and BridgeAAC says it out loud with natural voices that run on the device, so it keeps working without internet. It comes with ready-made boards and 600+ original symbols, and it imports ce and Open Board files. Works on iPad, iPhone, Android, Chromebook and computers. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: Let's Seedance
records.tagline: Explore ideas with AI video and image tools
records.description: LetsSeedance is an online AI video and image creation platform. Turn text or images into short visual content, explore frame controls, and refine ideas with editing tools. It is designed for creators preparing clips and vertical presentations. Free exploration uses limited credits; available models and features depend on your plan.

records.name: Reroute
records.tagline: Per-app proxy for Mac, alongside Tailscale and VPN apps
records.description: Turn on a VPN and every app goes with it. Reroute runs alongside Tailscale and VPN apps and sends only the Mac apps you pick through your own SOCKS5, HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Helper processes follow the same rule. Activity shows every connection and the route it took, and Test shows the IP and country a proxy presents. If the proxy drops, routed apps stop instead of quietly using your normal connection. £9.99 once for up to 3 Macs, with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: ErisPulse
records.tagline: Write once, run your bot on 20+ messaging platforms
records.description: ErisPulse is an async, event-driven Python bot framework: write once, deploy to QQ, Telegram, Discord, Kook, Yunhu, WeChat and 20+ messengers on one event model. 64 installable modules — 20 platform adapters + 44 extensions: epsdk install Telegram Dashboard QvQChat MyServer. Modules own every resource they register (routes, tasks, handlers, i18n); unload one and the framework reclaims it automatically. Hot-reload with rollback, scope-based permissions, MIT: github.com/ErisPulse/ErisPulse

records.name: Space
records.tagline: Edit files in macOS Quick Look with plugins
records.description: Text files in Quick Look can't be pinch-zoomed, have no color, and can't be edited. To fix a few words, you double-click, wait for another app to launch, and then either forget to quit it or have to press ⌘Q. The text is already in front of you. You should be able to just edit it. With Space, press space, pinch to zoom, and press ⌘L to edit in place. Free plugins add syntax colors for 100+ languages and beautiful Markdown. Vim mode included.

records.name: Precheckly
records.tagline: Catch failed texts and A2P problems before carriers do
records.description: Precheckly checks what businesses and agencies send from HighLevel and Twilio. Free tools check A2P 10DLC sample messages, SMS segment counts and email domain setup, and a free Chrome extension counts segments as you type in HighLevel. Paid plans read connected accounts every day and show which texts never arrived and why, and who was texted after replying STOP. Precheckly never sends messages.

records.name: OnMap.me
records.tagline: One page that gets a local business found by AI
records.description: OnMap.me makes one page for a local business in the United States, written so ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude can find and quote it. Claim onmap.me/@yourbusiness in a short chat. The page states what you do, where, your hours, prices and answers to common questions as plain text and structured data, open to AI crawlers. A new local guide is added every week. Basic is $29 a month. Pro is $99 and adds a monthly report of how often AI crawlers read the page.

records.name: Lumi
records.tagline: Break the spiral
records.description: Overthinking, anxious or restless? Tell Lumi how you feel and how much time you have. She lights up and picks one small step, like slow breathing, a short walk or a journaling prompt, each backed by a cited study. No library to scroll. She learns which steps actually help you. A wellness companion, not therapy.

records.name: The Mirror by hōm CREATE
records.tagline: Ask your body one honest question. Get four answers.
records.description: Type one honest sentence: "my jaw hurts every morning when I wake up." The Mirror reads it four ways, through the body, the pattern, the inheritance and the belief, then hands you the floor underneath it and an affirmation to keep. Three readings free, no sign-up.

records.name: BOND
records.tagline: Find your people. Same city, same vibe.
records.description: BOND is your social concierge for city life. Pick your vibes (badminton, cafés, gigs, trekking) and match with people nearby who share them. Then meet IRL through curated circles: verified local events with transparent pricing and instant passes.

records.name: Omni Video
records.tagline: Turn text and images into AI video clips
records.description: Create short AI videos from text prompts and reference images in your browser. Describe your subject, setting, camera movement, and mood, then generate a clip and refine your next take. Omni Video helps creators and teams explore scenes for social posts, product demonstrations, advertisements, and presentations.

records.name: Boomship
records.tagline: Build, design, research & automate in one AI workspace
records.description: Boomship is your AI Work OS for turning ideas into finished work. Build and debug apps, create documents and decks, research with your project's context, and coordinate actions across connected tools, all in one workspace. Choose your model or bring your own keys. Every job ends with a Work Receipt: what happened, what was verified, and what wasn't. Free to start; plans from $14 a month.

records.name: Duty Rewards
records.tagline: Find military benefits, veteran discounts and planning tools
records.description: Duty Rewards brings military benefits, veteran discounts and financial planning tools into one place for U.S. veterans, active-duty service members, Guard and Reserve members, and military families. Explore federal and state benefits for education, health, housing and travel. Estimate military pay and VA disability compensation, plan retirement and TSP savings, track credit-card benefits, and save useful resources. Available on the web and mobile, with practical guides to help you get started.

records.name: Little Tales
records.tagline: A private photo journal: one photo + one line a day
records.description: Keep a little of every day without the effort of a diary. Add one photo and one line (or a voice note), and it becomes a postage stamp on your private scrapbook calendar. Decorate stamps with stickers, filters and handwriting, and watch your week play back as a little film. Free for 7 days.

records.name: Mó Paz
records.tagline: Only your contacts can ring
records.description: Mó Paz blocks calls from numbers outside your contacts, silences promo SMS and voicemail alerts, and keeps everything on your phone. Always-allowed exceptions for delivery, clinic or bank, a night mode, and a calm weekly view of what was blocked. No account, no data leaves your device.

records.name: Promptvane
records.tagline: Free AI Visibility Checker & GEO Tracking Tool
records.description: Track brand mentions and citations across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. Start with a free website check and 3 ChatGPT questions.

records.name: OwlComp
records.tagline: A software company run by AI agents, building live
records.description: OwlComp is a software company staffed by AI agents. A CXO plans the work, divisions build it, and a review panel checks every change before it lands. Watch it work live, vote on what it builds next, and try every app it finishes.

records.name: Scormbee
records.tagline: Build interactive SCORM courses in your browser, from $5/mo
records.description: Scormbee turns briefs, PDFs and PowerPoint decks into interactive SCORM courses. Quizzes, branching scenarios and games, SCORM 1.2/2004, xAPI and cmi5 export on every plan, and Dynamic SCORM to update a course in every LMS without re-uploading. Free plan, paid from $5/month.

records.name: Personalisation Hub
records.tagline: Build and own a retail media network in an industry you love
records.description: Considering going out on your own? Build and own a retail media network in an industry you love: golf clubs, car dealerships, fuel and convenience, liquor stores, marinas and more. Sell screen time to brands across your venues, and let AI build, target and optimise every campaign on real in-store sales. White-label, under your own brand, in your own AWS account. Start without the upfront cost: a free runway to roll out, then grow on outcomes.

records.name: Lirico
records.tagline: Synced lyrics in your Windows taskbar, any language
records.description: Lirico puts live, synced lyrics on your screen while a song plays on YouTube or Spotify. A clean overlay sits above your taskbar, so you can sing along without switching tabs. Free for Windows.

records.name: Prime Calendar
records.tagline: The calendar your family, your AI agent and your home share
records.description: Prime Calendar brings Google and Outlook into one calendar your household or team can actually share, with permissions set per calendar. Type "Dentist friday 3pm for 45 min" to add an event, see everyone's day side by side in People view, or switch to Focus mode when you need quiet. Rules automate colors, tasks and webhooks (Home Assistant ready), and an MCP server lets Claude and other AI agents manage your schedule within limits you set. English, Hungarian, German, French.

records.name: Lunara
records.tagline: Spot patterns in your sleep during perimenopause
records.description: Lunara is a 60-second morning check-in for women in perimenopause and menopause. Log sleep, wake-ups, hot flashes, caffeine, alcohol and stress, then see weekly observations about what tends to show up on your harder nights. Includes wind-down tools for 3am wake-ups and a printable summary to share with your doctor. Not a medical device.

records.name: DailyDrills for Excel
records.tagline: Practice Excel daily, in your own language
records.description: Short daily Excel drills that run in your browser, with function names in your language: SUM, SOMME or SUMME, as your Excel shows it. Available in 11 languages, with guides and exercises from basics to advanced. Start for free.

records.name: Red Dirt Pro Studio Version 7.2.8
records.tagline: A complete record label in one program for Windows
records.description: Red Dirt Pro Studio Version 7.2.8 is a complete record label in one program: write, record, mix and master on your own Windows computer — no subscription. It comes with a named band inside: Shoelace on fiddle, Joni Marie Flanary on bass and Dale Whitefield on mandolin. Your songs save to your own computer, and your music is yours — download it as many times as you like. The first 100 copies are $250, lifetime. From Redemption Road Music Group in Abilene, Texas.

records.name: Lpdfi Sign Image
records.tagline: Sign a photo of any document, with the date, no printer
records.description: Someone sends you a form or receipt on WhatsApp and needs your signature today. Open Lpdfi Sign Image, add the photo, then draw your signature, upload it, or snap your real signature on paper (the white paper is removed). Add the date and time, place it on the line and download. Sign up to 30 images at once. Runs in your browser: nothing is uploaded, no sign-up, no watermark. Formerly LovePDFi.

records.name: Chalkie
records.tagline: Ask anything. Watch it drawn and explained on a live board.
records.description: Ask a question and Chalkie draws the answer on a board, stroke by stroke, while a voice explains each part. No walls of text. Circle any part of the drawing and ask about it, or type a follow-up, and it keeps drawing on the same board. Each lesson also gives you a 3D model on request, notes, a quiz, and a video export. Try free, no sign-in: chalkie.in/try. Plans from $4.99/mo.

records.name: Scalp Score
records.tagline: Shedding, oily or flaky scalp? Get your Scalp Score, free
records.description: Shedding, an oily or flaky scalp, or breakage? Answer five questions for a free Scalp Score, no sign-up. Check products by barcode, name or ingredient photo, build a routine around your wash days, and keep a photo journal. No ads, no commissions. Android.

records.name: entroit
records.tagline: ERP software to handle more orders without more admin
records.description: ERP software for wholesale, ecommerce, manufacturing and 3PL. Handle more orders without more admin. Your whole operation in one system. Go live in days, not weeks. With Professional, we migrate your data and train your team while your business keeps running. From €349 a month. No set-up fee. Free until it runs for you. See how it works.

records.name: ShareWithGuests
records.tagline: Beautiful Event Links for Your Guests
records.description: ShareWithGuests turns your event into one shareable link. Pick a theme, add your photos, then switch on the apps your guests need: find their seat on the floor plan, the day's schedule, the menu with dietary notes, a quiz played from their phones, and a shared reel where every photo and video lands in one place. Made for weddings, birthdays, christenings and trips away. Free to set up, then pay once per event when you're ready to share.

records.name: Strokes
records.tagline: Desktop writing app with offline AI and built-in readers
records.description: Strokes is a desktop editor for people who work with text most of their day. In Strokes you’ll find a personal AI writer, trained specifically to help you write in your own style faster, with no loss of quality. And you know what? The AI works both online and offline. Want full privacy? You got it. Built-in readers help you get feedback before you send your work to anyone. Available on Mac and Windows, with a free plan.

records.name: ZEUS
records.tagline: Local AI coding agent for your desktop
records.description: ZEUS is a desktop coding agent for Linux powered by your local Ollama models. Give it a task or attach a spec (.md, PDF, Word…) and it works in rounds until the result is verified. You approve every change or set to auto approve mode. Nothing leaves your machine. Open source.

records.name: LineCheck
records.tagline: On-Device AI Pregnancy & Ovulation Test Scanner
records.description: Review faint pregnancy and ovulation test lines with AI that runs on your phone. Enhance and compare test photos, track LH ratios and line progression, and keep cycle and pregnancy logs together. Available on iPhone, iPad and Android. Test photos stay on-device for scanning; optional Luna chat uses online services. Free to download with optional Pro features. Informational only; not a medical device.

records.name: MoveInCheck
records.tagline: Your first flat in a new city, checked before you pay.
records.description: Moving to a new city and can’t visit a flat before paying the deposit? MoveInCheck sends a trained local checker to inspect it for you. You get a photo-backed report showing what matches the listing, what doesn’t, and what to ask the landlord before you sign.

records.name: Scatter
records.tagline: Study with AI on a mind map that grows with each question
records.description: I’m a psychiatry resident with ADHD. I built Scatter because AI chats felt too constrained for the way I wanted to study. You can preview unfamiliar terms and open follow-up questions as branches on a map, so the original explanation stays in view. It’s free with your own API key.

records.name: AlpenShield
records.tagline: Keep cold sales emails out of your Microsoft 365 inbox
records.description: AlpenShield identifies unsolicited B2B sales outreach in Microsoft 365 while keeping real client enquiries in your inbox. Start in Monitor mode to review suggestions without moving messages, allow trusted contacts, then enable reversible sorting into a dedicated folder (zero auto-deletion). Supports individual mailboxes, company-wide M365 deployment & MSP multi-client management. Built in Switzerland. 14-day trial with card, then CHF 5.90/address/mo.

records.name: College GPA Calculator
records.tagline: Credit-weighted college GPA, updated as you type
records.description: A free college GPA calculator that weights every course by its credit hours. Enter your courses, letter grades and credits, and see your term GPA, total credits and grade points update as you type. Uses the standard 4.0 scale with plus and minus grades. Works on phones, needs no sign up, and pairs with cumulative GPA and GPA needed calculators.

records.name: Learn Piano Easy
records.tagline: A guided course, a 3D piano
records.description: Learn piano by playing. A guided course, a 3D piano and your MIDI keyboard. Free, open source and offline.

records.name: Unweighted GPA Calculator
records.tagline: Find your unweighted GPA on the 4.0 scale in seconds
records.description: A free, fast unweighted GPA calculator for middle school, high school and college students. Add your courses, letter grades and credits, and your GPA updates as you type. Every class counts the same on the standard 4.0 scale, with plus and minus grades supported. It shows total credits and grade points, works on phones, and needs no sign up.

records.name: Microphone Selector and Recommendation
records.tagline: Discover the Perfect Microphone for Every Recording Setup.
records.description: Find the best mic for podcasting, streaming, gaming & studio. Compare USB, XLR & wireless picks by budget — free, no sign-up.

records.name: Slotlock
records.tagline: Slotlock: the booking API and calendar for AI agents
records.description: Give AI agents a calendar for every car, room, machine or person. Find, hold and book slots over MCP, A2A or REST, and PostgreSQL refuses double bookings.

records.name: Apocalypse Mascots
records.tagline: A Lovecraftian mascot that grows as your coding agent works
records.description: A free mascot for your coding agent, now in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more. Yoggy, after Yog-Sothoth, and Shubby, after Shub-Niggurath, grow with what you hand the agent: eyes when it reads your files, hands when it edits them, then your shell, the open web, your other apps, and more copies of itself. A caption keeps the tally. It makes no network calls and keeps none of your prompts. Three of six color schemes are out. Shoggy, the third form, is next.

records.name: Tilery
records.tagline: Tile rummy with friends, daily puzzles and a voice AI rival
records.description: Make your next break a game of tile rummy. Play online with friends, challenge clever bots, or solve a daily puzzle. On iPhone, iPad and Android, a voice AI opponent talks back as you play. Try the first browser puzzle without an email or download, or play with friends on Discord.

records.name: Moses Mastery Store Scanner
records.tagline: Free Shopify store scanner
records.description: Paste your Shopify store link and see your score, plus speed, mobile, SEO, trust and conversion checks, on the page in seconds. No signup, no email. Download the report as a PDF and see what to fix first.

records.name: Snip
records.tagline: The new way to find tailors near you.
records.description: Snip is an early-access website for discovering and booking verified tailors, boutiques and designers near you in Delhi. Browse a map, filter by service and send a booking request with your preferred date and a home or studio visit. Designers can create a studio profile, add services and manage booking requests. We're looking to onboard our first studios and would love feedback on the idea and booking flow.

records.name: AskPragzy
records.tagline: Validate your idea & know which answers to trust
records.description: AskPragzy helps first-time founders ask better questions, trust the right answers and know what to do next, before they build.

records.name: ShuttleClip
records.tagline: AI finds every rally in your badminton video
records.description: ShuttleClip is an AI video editor for badminton players. Pick a match video and it finds every rally on your phone, selects the best ones, and exports a highlight reel or separate clips. No account, no uploads.

records.name: Hollowcross
records.tagline: A free gothic-horror card battler you play in your browser
records.description: Hollowcross is a free gothic-horror card battler with 306 unique cards across 17 races, each with its own signature ability, and five fully voiced modes: a story Saga, Warfront grid tactics, a Souls deck climb, real-time Siege and the Gauntlet. It runs in any modern browser with nothing to install, and there's a desktop client on Steam.

records.name: Schwanki
records.tagline: Spaced repetition you can scroll
records.description: Schwanki turns flashcards into a vertical feed. Swipe up to see the meaning, right if you got it, left if you forgot. FSRS schedules the rest. Bring your Anki decks with their review history, or add class notes from PDFs (Canva exports too), Google Docs or a whiteboard photo.

records.name: Fold
records.tagline: Notes without the noise
records.description: A quiet, private, hardware-grade notes workspace for the web. Capture thoughts instantly, persist them on-device with IndexedDB, and keep your mind calm. Zero tracking, zero cloud, zero accounts.

records.name: Giov
records.tagline: AI customer support across channels and inside your app
records.description: AI support without the enterprise price tag. Start free, or get GiovBot, 10 operators and 500 AI credits for $19.99/month on Pro. Manage web chat, email and messaging in one inbox. Giov Copilot helps signed-in users through confirmed API/MCP actions. Security includes MFA, roles and OAuth with scoped MCP permissions. Higher plans add all messaging channels, SSO/SCIM and Copilot.

records.name: CORPULATE
records.tagline: US and UK company formation for non-residents
records.description: CORPULATE helps founders outside the US launch a US or UK company fully online. As an IRS Certified Acceptance Agent, we verify ITIN identity documents remotely, so no passports are mailed, and handle LLC formation, EIN and tax filings with no SSN or travel. ITIN help starts from $99.

records.name: Drasken Cloud
records.tagline: Managed and monitored hosting in India
records.description: Run your apps and PostgreSQL, MySQL or Valkey databases in Mumbai without managing servers. You get HTTPS, daily database backups, health checks, logs, metrics and email alerts, so you hear about a problem before your customers do. Prices are fixed in rupees, with a GST invoice and UPI payments.

records.name: Brain Rush Daily
records.tagline: 5-minute brain games
records.description: Quick, playful mind games for memory, focus, speed and logic.

records.name: Dola AI
records.tagline: Turn text and photos into AI videos and images
records.description: Create short videos and images from text prompts or reference photos with Dola AI. Switch between text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-image, and AI image editing in your browser. Choose available models and formats, check the credit cost, then generate and download visuals for social posts, product showcases, and marketing.

records.name: NetFixLab
records.tagline: Your home runs on a network. Learn it from a comic.
records.description: Ever wondered how a video reaches your phone, or why the Wi-Fi drops? NetFixLab explains networking through comics and animated videos, then you crack real network cases like a detective. No tech background needed. Start from zero and go as far as you like.

records.name: BriskToolbox
records.tagline: Free Financial & Health Calculators
records.description: Free financial and health calculators that show the whole picture: 66 calculators for mortgage, auto, personal and student loans, savings and retirement, plus BMI, calories and other health tools, with full amortization schedules, payoff charts and extra-payment savings. No sign-up, calculated in your browser.
